enonce_markdown: A transport agency in Douala pays a software house to write a booking program that follows the agency's own rules and is used by that agency only. What type of software is this?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Software is classified by who it is made for. A program written to the specification of one client is custom-written (bespoke); a program made for many buyers and sold ready-made is off-the-shelf.

### Solution

The program is built for one client and follows its own rules, so it is **custom-written (bespoke) software** (option c). Off-the-shelf software is bought ready-made, general-purpose software can be used for many kinds of task, and utility software maintains the computer rather than doing the user's work.

enonce_markdown: Which of the following is an example of application software?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Application software performs a task wanted by the user (writing, calculating, presenting). Software that manages the hardware or maintains the system is system software.

### Solution

A spreadsheet package is used to carry out the user's own task of calculating, so it is **application software** (option a). A disk defragmenter is a utility (system software), a compiler is a language translator (system software) and a device driver lets the operating system control a device (system software).

enonce_markdown:
The head teacher of a secondary school in Bamenda must choose software to produce the term report cards. One option is a package bought ready-made from a shop; the other is a program written by a local developer for the school.

Give TWO advantages of the ready-made package and TWO advantages of the program written for the school.
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Compare the two options on cost, delivery time, reliability, fit to the user's needs and support. Ready-made software is made for many users; custom software is made for one.

### Solution

**Ready-made (off-the-shelf) package**

- It is cheaper, because the development cost is shared among many buyers.
- It is available immediately and has already been tested by many users, so it contains fewer errors.

**Program written for the school (custom-written)**

- It fits the school's own report-card layout and grading rules exactly, so no procedure has to be changed.
- The developer can add new features on request, and the school has no unused functions.

(Other accepted points: off-the-shelf software has wide documentation and user forums; custom software gives the school control over later changes.)

enonce_markdown: A small shop in Buea is choosing between off-the-shelf software and custom-written software for its accounts. Which statement is an advantage of off-the-shelf software over custom-written software?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Off-the-shelf software spreads its development cost over many buyers, so it is usually cheaper and ready at once. Custom software costs more and takes time, but it fits the user exactly.

### Solution

Option d is the advantage of off-the-shelf software: it is usually **cheaper and available immediately**. The other three options are advantages of custom-written software: matching the shop's own procedures (a), asking the developer to add features for the shop alone (b), and having no unused functions (c).

choix.texte: It matches exactly the shop's own procedures
The developer can be asked to add features for the shop alone
It contains no functions that the shop will never use
It is usually cheaper and available immediately

A student is given six programs. Copy and complete the table by writing *system software* or *application software* for each program, with a reason of a few words.

| Program | Type | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Payroll package | | |
| Linux | | |
| Web browser | | |
| Disk defragmenter | | |
| C compiler | | |
| Presentation package | | |
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

System software controls and maintains the computer (operating system, utilities, translators, drivers). Application software does a job the user wants done.

### Solution

| Program | Type | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Payroll package | Application | Calculates and prints salaries, a task wanted by the user |
| Linux | System | It is an operating system that manages hardware and other programs |
| Web browser | Application | Lets the user view web pages |
| Disk defragmenter | System (utility) | Maintains the disk by regrouping the fragments of files |
| C compiler | System (language translator) | Translates source code into machine code |
| Presentation package | Application | Used to create slides |

enonce_markdown: An accounting package is sold in computer shops and can be bought by any small business. It does one kind of job only, keeping accounting records. How should it be classified?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Two separate questions are asked: who the software was made for (one client or many buyers) and how wide its use is (one kind of task or many tasks). Do not merge them.

### Solution

It is sold ready-made to any buyer, so it is **off-the-shelf**. It performs one kind of job only (accounting), so it is **special-purpose** and not general-purpose, which would be usable for many different tasks such as a word processor or a spreadsheet. The answer is option b. Option a confuses who bought it with how it was made; options c and d call it general-purpose or custom-written, which does not fit.
